As Qualcomm (QCOM) Share Price Declined, Holder Old National Bancorp Cut Its Holding; Woodstock Has Boosted Apple (AAPL) Holding
June 2, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Woodstock Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 6.05% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Woodstock Corp bought 3,700 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 64,847 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.88 million, up from 61,147 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Woodstock Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06B market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Old National Bancorp decreased its stake in Qualcomm Inc (QCOM) by 57.81% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Old National Bancorp sold 17,038 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 12,436 shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $689,000, down from 29,474 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Old National Bancorp who had been investing in Qualcomm Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $86.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.84% or $0.49 during the last trading session, reaching $58.61. About 7.44 million shares traded. QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) has risen 2.58% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) to report earnings on July, 18. They expect $0.58 EPS, down 17.14% or $0.12 from last year’s $0.7 per share. QCOM’s profit will be $859.92 million for 25.26 P/E if the $0.58 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.67 actual EPS reported by QUALCOMM Incorporated for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -13.43% negative EPS growth.
